mandates_signed.name: mandates_signed
mandates_signed.value: "mandates"."status" not in ('ACTIVE', 'FROZEN') or "mandates"."signed_at" is not null

actions_moves_money.name: actions_moves_money
actions_moves_money.value: "actions"."type" not in ('AUTHORIZE', 'CAPTURE', 'REFUND', 'PAYOUT') or "actions"."amount_minor" is not null

actions_mandate.name: actions_mandate
actions_mandate.value: "actions"."type" not in ('FREEZE', 'REVOKE') or "actions"."mandate_id" is not null

approvals_who.name: approvals_who
approvals_who.value: "approvals"."decided_at" is null or "approvals"."approver_id" is not null
